    # Fill the title textbox if not already filled
    title_textbox = page.get_by_role("textbox", name="Title")
    await title_textbox.fill("Integrating LLMs for better prompts")
    
    # Select 'Roshanjossey' from the expanded assignee dropdown using a text-based selector

    roshan_option = page.get_by_text("Roshanjossey", exact=True)
    await roshan_option.click()
    
    # Fill the due date textbox with the beginning of Q2 2033 (April 1, 2033)
    due_date_textbox = page.get_by_role("textbox", name="Select due date")
    await due_date_textbox.fill("2033-04-01")
    
    # Submit the issue form
    submit_button = page.get_by_role("button", name="Submit issue")
    await submit_button.click()
